title: Rumeli Hisarı
identityStatus: Exact named Q90801 fortress relation. Native East/South frame; wall/court coordinates remain separate from original tower height, forecourt and current-state interpretations.

largeTowers.name: Çandarlı Halil Paşa Tower
largeTowers.radiusBasis: Photo-informed polygonal lower base; mapped curve supplies upper crown only. 26.7m reconstructed exterior is approximate.

mosque.basis: Mapped mosque envelope; roof and surviving minaret stub interpreted from references, not surveyed/current-state verified.

nativeAxes.origin: Exact-QID cached map anchor; native Y0 is coarse DEM sample-grid minimum, not real host ground datum.

reconstruction.basis: Independent OSM member coordinates with original interpretation of primary Turkish Museums photos/site plan, published component heights and municipal laser-scan article.
reconstruction.sourceMemberRoles: Relation assigns outer to the smaller court and inner to the larger tower contour. Roles appear reversed; raw roles are preserved. Geometry uses the larger ring as site outline and the smaller as open courtyard, not a blind solid relation extrusion.
reconstruction.scope: Fortress exterior, three stepped hollow towers, mapped minor bastions, estimated forecourt defenses, mapped mosque envelope and terrain-following curtains.
reconstruction.referenceState: Roofless restored fortress interpretation. Exact current restoration, mosque and visitor infrastructure require review.
